ABOUT BKMUN

An initiative built
by students.

BKMUN is an independent, student-led Model United Nations initiative based in Kazakhstan. We bring students together to explore international affairs through debate, negotiation and collaborative resolution writing.

Our conferences give participants a place to represent different perspectives, question their assumptions and work through disagreements. First-time delegates take part alongside students with previous MUN experience.

FOR DELEGATES

Your first MUN?
Start here.

You do not need to have all the answers. You need to be ready to research, listen and take part.

Open Delegate Hub
What happens at a Model UN conference?

You represent an assigned country in a simulated committee. You prepare its position, deliver speeches, discuss proposals and work with other delegates on a draft resolution.

Can I take part without experience?

Yes. The October conference welcomes both first-time and experienced delegates aged 14–18. The working language is English.

How should I prepare?

Once your country and committee are assigned, read the study materials, research your country's position and prepare your opening remarks. Check the official channel for conference instructions.

How do I register?

Use the registration button above to complete the Google Form for the 3–4 October conference. Participation is online and free of charge.
